name: Specimen timeline
interaction: Select a numbered specimen and edit its effective session time beside its immutable timeline.
functional_difference: The session and original scan are visible together while editing one specimen.
benefit: Makes the difference between an observation and a correction easy to inspect.
risk: Slow when many specimens need the same correction.
backend_change: Existing timestamp correction supports the concept; specimen-specific selection and timeline are presentation changes. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Select specimen 02 or 03.
Enter a reason, then Save timestamp correction.
Set entry to11:00 to see future-time rejection, or exit08:30 to see chronology rejection.
Select Stale edit or Unavailable in the external demo harness and try saving.

name: Staged spreadsheet ledger
interaction: Edit multiple proposed-time cells, stage them, then commit the reviewed batch.
functional_difference: Four per-row edits share a staged transaction with one reason.
benefit: Efficient for corrections affecting several records at once.
risk: Cell editing can obscure the impact unless staging is mandatory.
backend_change: Policy/interface extension: existing API edits one session at a time; needs a transactional bulk correction endpoint and row versions. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Change one proposed time and enter a reason.
Stage 4 cell edits; confirm the table says Staged with0 committed.
Commit 4 staged edits and inspect the immutable original 09:12 row.
Reset, stage again, select Stale edit, then commit to see0 specimens changed.

name: Guided correction wizard
interaction: Identify the issue, review a readable proposal, then explicitly confirm.
functional_difference: Progressive three-step flow separates entry, review, and recording.
benefit: Reduces accidental correction for infrequent supervisors.
backend_change: Existing correction API; guidance and review stages can remain local UI state. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Choose a correction type and enter a reason.
Review this correction to move from Identify to Review.
Confirm reviewed correction; observeRecord step and retained original scan.
Try Unavailable or Stale edit before final confirmation.

name: Before and after comparison
interaction: Compare current and proposed session fields in two aligned panels.
functional_difference: A review-first diff makes the precise changed field the dominant view.
benefit: Useful when an approver needs to understand the change quickly.
risk: Less efficient for many small edits.
backend_change: Existing correction API with current stack version included in the reviewed request. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Compare observed 09:12 with claimed 08:45 and recording 10:05.
Enter a reason and apply the reviewed difference.
Reset and enter a future time to test rejection.

name: Exception triage inbox
interaction: Choose a discrepancy case from a queue and resolve it with a reviewed correction.
functional_difference: Work begins from reported exceptions rather than searching raw specimen history.
benefit: Directs supervisor attention to unresolved problems.
risk: Requires ownership rules so multiple reviewers do not duplicate work.
backend_change: Concept extension: persisted exception cases, status, ownership, and resolution references; correction uses the existing core service. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Select CT-105 missing entry or CT-106 room discrepancy.
Enter a resolution reason, then resolve the selected exception.
Observe only the selected ticket’s status change and retained scan history.
Try Stale edit or Unavailable and confirm no case resolves.

name: Undo impact preview
interaction: Review all20affected specimens before confirming one undo.
functional_difference: Eligibility and consequences are shown before the reversal.
risk: An undo can be blocked by one later event and requires a different correction path.
backend_change: Existing guarded undo; preview endpoint or read-only impact calculation would improve the UI. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Enter a reason and Preview undo impact.
Confirm undo of 20 sessions; inspect retained original IN event.
Reset and select Intervening movement in the harness.
Try preview again: specimen 03 blocks the entire undo.

name: Missed entry reconstruction
interaction: Reconcile a claimed physical entry, observed evidence, and the time the supervisor records it.
functional_difference: Three parallel accounts distinguish claimed time, existing observations, and recording time.
benefit: Avoids turning an operator account into a fabricated scanner event.
risk: Claimed residence time needs a reliable documented basis.
backend_change: Existing missed-session correction supports source and recorded_at; evidence references would be an extension. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Enter a reason explaining the missed scan.
Build reconstructed session to inspect the claim/source separation.
Record reconstructed session; confirm source missed entry and recorded 10:05.
Enter exit earlier than entry to see chronology rejection.

name: Atomic group time adjustment
interaction: Select a group of specimens, preview a shared entry-time adjustment, then commit atomically.
functional_difference: Selection and group impact are visible before a single all-or-none write.
benefit: Handles stack-wide transcription errors with consistent reasoning.
risk: An overly broad selection can alter specimens with different physical histories.
backend_change: Concept extension: transactional bulk-session correction with expected versions for every selected specimen. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Clear selection, then select specimens01–05, or choose Select all.
Enter a shared reason and preview the selected adjustments.
Commit selected time adjustments and inspect original 09:12 history.
Stage a group, select Stale edit, then commit to see entire batch rejection.

name: Two person approval queue
interaction: Eva approves first; Noah independently approves before any effective time changes.
functional_difference: Requires two distinct approvals and records each review separately.
benefit: Adds deliberate scrutiny to consequential corrections.
risk: Slower resolution and reviewer availability dependencies.
backend_change: Explicit policy concept: needs approval records, distinct reviewer enforcement, pending statuses, and atomic final approval; current backend has a single supervisor correction. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Enter a rationale and approve as Eva Morales.
Inspect pending state: effective entry still 09:12.
Approve independently as Noah Chen; confirm correction recorded 10:11 with both reviews retained.
Use Stale edit before final approval to see0 changes.

name: Operator request and supervisor review
interaction: An operator submits a discrepancy request; a supervisor later reviews and approves it.
functional_difference: Request recorded 10:05is a different event from approval/correction recorded 10:11.
benefit: Operators can capture context without permission to alter sessions.
risk: Requests need routing and a clear pending state.
backend_change: Concept extension: request entities, operator capture authorization, reviewer actions, and request-to-correction links.
trial_actions: Enter an operator account and Submit correction request.
Inspect the request lifecycle and unchanged original 09:12effective time.
Approve request as supervisor to record the separate 10:11 correction.
Select Unavailable before either action and verify no new event records.

name: Room reconciliation worksheet
interaction: Compare physical inventory with recorded location and verify a mismatch before correcting it.
functional_difference: The starting point is a shelf check across three rooms, not a timestamp form.
benefit: Finds mistakes that ordinary scan history will not reveal.
risk: Requires precise specimen identification during the physical check.
backend_change: Concept extension: reconciliation-check records and verified findings; room/session correction can use existing core correction behavior. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Check the physical verification for specimen 19.
Choose its confirmed room, enter a reason, and review the mismatch.
Record verified room correction; inspect original Shared 09:12 history.
Try without physical verification to see rejection.

name: Project case workbench
interaction: Inspect chronology and operator notes while composing a correction in a persistent case inspector.
functional_difference: Case context remains available as a correction is recorded.
benefit: Supports complex discrepancies spanning several people or observations.
risk: A case workspace can be excessive for simple one-time errors.
backend_change: Concept extension: case records, linked notes, and correction associations; core correction API remains reusable. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Switch between Chronology, Operator notes, and Case actions.
Enter a rationale and Record correction in this case.
Inspect Case actions and immutable audit to see the new event.

name: Handheld incident capture
device: Handheld touch device or scanner-equipped phone
interaction: Identify a specimen, choose an incident type, and capture a short account for later review.
functional_difference: A narrow touch flow captures a request and never applies a correction.
benefit: Preserves details where the problem is noticed.
risk: Captured requests can remain unresolved without a review queue.
backend_change: Concept extension: persisted incident/request capture; no supervisor correction permission on this device.
trial_actions: Choose Wrong room or Missed IN scan.
Keep demo specimen UL1:P:0007-03 or enter another recognized numbered code.
Enter a short account and Capture incident for review.
Confirm original effective entry stays 09:12 and request is recorded 10:05.

name: Keyboard command palette
interaction: Type a structured correction command, dry-run it, then execute its reviewed effect.
functional_difference: Intent is expressed through a keyboard grammar with explicit preview and execution.
benefit: Fast for experienced operators and accessibility-friendly keyboard work.
risk: Command interpretation must remain unambiguous and previewed.
backend_change: Concept extension: strict client/server command parser translating to existing correction/undo APIs, with expected versions. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Use a sample command or type “correct #03 entered 08:45”.
Enter a reason and Dry-run this command; Ctrl + Enter also triggers review.
Execute reviewed command and inspect retained original log.
Choose Undo last movement with Intervening movement to see atomic block.
Enter “correct #03 entered 11:00” to test future-time rejection.

name: Read only kiosk handoff
device: Room touchscreen, USB scanner, or scanner-only request capture
interaction: Scan a specimen, scan a printed reason-card code, then scan SEND to capture a review ticket; touch controls offer the same path.
functional_difference: The kiosk produces a review reference while leaving all effective session records read-only.
benefit: Keeps correction requests available where the scanner already lives.
risk: Physical or digital tickets need a dependable handoff process.
backend_change: Concept extension: request capture and ticket/reference generation; no kiosk correction permission.
trial_actions: Choose a reason category; scan or type UL1:P:0007-03.
Create supervisor handoff ticket, or press Enter in the scan input after selecting a reason.
Scanner-only trial: reset, scan UL1:P:0007-03 and Enter, scan WHY:LATE and Enter, then scan SEND and Enter.
Inspect ticket CT-104 and distinct observed09:12,claimed08:45,request-recorded 10:05times.
Select Unavailable and ensure a ticket is not issued.

name: Evidence backed correction case
interaction: Select supporting records, link them to a proposal, then record an evidence-supported correction.
functional_difference: Evidence selection is part of the reviewed correction flow rather than an optional note.
benefit: Makes the reasoning and supporting material traceable.
risk: Evidence collection adds work and needs retention policies if implemented.
backend_change: Concept extension: evidence metadata, references or attachments, authorization, and correction links; existing correction API stores the reason. The simulated stale-edit guard additionally needs correction-version preconditions; current correction requests do not carry an expected version.
trial_actions: Select supporting evidence and optionally attach the simulated operator note.
Enter an interpretation and Link evidence and review.
Record supported correction; inspect linked evidence names in the immutable audit addition.
Clear all evidence to see validation rejection.
